Project Name: Metro Train Maintenance – Fault Detection Web App
Problem Identification: Predict whether a fault will occur from metro train/manufacturing sensor signals and provide a simple web app for training + real-time prediction.
Data issues / EDA: SQLite dataset (fault_detection_manufacturing); very strong class imbalance (fault_occurred: 0=810,517 vs 1=126); numeric sensor ranges vary; missing/invalid values handled; negative class subsampled for training to include both classes.
ML Model: LogisticRegression (balanced) and XGBoost supported; probability outputs; evaluation can be Random (stratified 80/20) or Time‑Based (train before last positive timestamp, test from last positive onward; no shuffle/stratify).
Preprocess: Numeric coercion; median imputation; StandardScaler; consistent feature schema saved; in temporal mode, no shuffle; speed mode downsamples negatives in TRAIN only (test intact).
Results: Flask API + HTML/CSS/JS UI: split selector (Random/Time‑Based) with timestamp column; metrics (Accuracy/Precision/Recall/F1/ROC AUC/PR AUC); threshold suggestions (best F1 and best@recall target); production guard requires Time‑Based split, SMOTE off, and at least one positive in the time‑based test window; endpoints verified (/api/train, /api/predict, /api/model_promote, /api/model_info).
Business Impact: Enables early fault detection and proactive maintenance planning; reduces unexpected breakdowns and service disruption; improves safety and maintenance efficiency by prioritizing high‑risk conditions; time‑aware evaluation with real future events increases reliability for production.
